Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 9 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Southwest Monsoon (Habagat)
Issued at: 11:00 AM, 06 July 2025(Sunday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales and Bataan.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Cavite, Metro Manila and Rizal within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Pampanga, Bulacan, Tarlac(Capas, Concepcion, Bamban) and Nueva Ecija(San Antonio, Jaen, San Leonardo, General Tinio, Cabiao, Penaranda, San Isidro, Gapan) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 2:00 PM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
